title: OpenProposal plain-generator exemptions
description: The parity cases where the classes a plain generator writes from the published schema alone differ from the reference verdict or don't encode a value back, each under a numbered exemption with the reason (type rules § 10). The plain-generator gate fails on a divergence this file doesn't list, and on a listed one that no longer occurs.

generator.description: The generator and version the exemptions were checked against, such as `datamodel-code-generator 0.86.0`. It must be the pinned one.

locks.description: The locks it applies to; every lock when absent.

reason.description: What the generator does with the schema that makes the classes diverge.

cases.description: The parity cases it covers, each by its label and how it diverges.

kind.description: `verdict`: the classes reach the other verdict. `error`: they raise something other than a rejection. `encoding`: they accept the value but encode it back as another JSON value.
